Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveNeedItemForN:
When enabled, the player must carry a charged GPS Navigator, or the vehicle must have a GPS Navigator installed and a battery with charge, before a route can be plotted.
Disabled (default) means anyone can plot a route at any time.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveNeedItemForA:
When enabled (default), the vehicle must have an Autopilot Module installed before auto-drive can start.
Disabled means any vehicle can auto-drive, which suits testing or casual play.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveAllowCraftGP:
Allows players to craft the GPS Navigator with the electrical recipe (Electrical 3 required).
When disabled the recipe cannot be performed. World loot and admin supply are controlled separately; existing items are unaffected.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveAllowCraftAu:
Allows players to craft the Autopilot Module with the electrical recipe (Electrical 6 required).
When disabled the recipe cannot be performed. World loot and admin supply are controlled separately; existing items are unaffected.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveSpawnGPS: Spawn GPS Navigators in world loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveSpawnGPS_too:
Enabled (default) adds GPS Navigators to loot rolls in army electronics storage, electronics-store miscellaneous stock, engineer tools, and electronics crates.
Disabled prevents new GPS loot. Existing items and containers that have already generated contents are not removed.
After an admin clicks Apply, containers whose contents have not yet generated use the new setting immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveSpawnAutopil: Spawn Autopilot Modules in world loot

Enabled (default) adds Autopilot Modules to loot rolls in army electronics storage, radio-factory components, and electronics-store computer stock.
Disabled prevents new module loot. Existing items and containers that have already generated contents are not removed.
After an admin clicks Apply, containers whose contents have not yet generated use the new setting immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveGPSPowerPerc:
Adjusts power used by active GPS navigation only. 100 is the default rate, 50 is half, 200 is double, and 0 disables this drain.
An installed GPS uses the vehicle battery; a carried GPS uses its own battery. While the engine runs, the vanilla alternator charges at the same time; throughout the 0–500 range the battery still gains net charge, while the multiplier changes recharge speed.
GPS and auto-drive power loads are added when both are active.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveAutoDrivePow:
Adjusts the vehicle-battery load while auto-drive is active only. 100 is the default rate, 50 is half, 200 is double, and 0 disables this drain.
Auto-drive requires the running engine, so the vanilla alternator charges at the same time; throughout the 0–500 range the battery still gains net charge, while the multiplier changes recharge speed. This load is added to the GPS load.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveGPSFuelPerce:
Adds fuel use while the driver navigates the vehicle with either an installed or a charged carried GPS. 100 adds 5%% to that vehicle's actual vanilla fuel burn, 200 adds 10%%, and 0 adds nothing.
A carried GPS still draws from its own battery; GPS and auto-drive fuel additions are summed when both are active.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveAutoDriveFue:
Adds fuel use only while auto-drive is active. 100 adds 25%% to that vehicle's actual vanilla fuel burn, 200 adds 50%%, and 0 adds nothing.
With GPS and auto-drive both active at 100, the total addition is 30%%; vanilla burn is not deducted twice.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveInstallSkill:
When enabled (default), installing or removing a GPS Navigator or Autopilot Module on a vehicle requires Electrical 1.
A screwdriver and a vehicle battery are always required regardless of this setting.
Disabled means anyone can install and remove the devices.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveAutoDriveMax:
Highest speed allowed while auto-driving.
Lower values are safer and less likely to hit obstacles; higher values are faster but riskier.
Actual speed is still limited by road conditions, vehicle performance and cornering slowdown.
After an admin clicks Apply, restart auto-drive to use the new limit.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveZombieAreaSl:
Detection range: individual zombies 2–48 metres ahead (110 metres with high-speed settings) and within 3 metres to either side of the driving line.
When enabled, 1–3 zombies cap speed at 25, 4–7 at 15, and 8 or more at 10 km/h. Zombies are not obstacles, so auto-drive will not swerve or stop for them.
Force slowdown applies this to everyone; Player choice (default) lets each player use the HUD/options; No zombie slowdown removes only this dedicated cap, while every other safety limit remains active.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveCorpseSlowdo:
Detection range: corpses on the ground 2–48 metres ahead (110 metres with high-speed settings) and within 3 metres to either side of the driving line.
When enabled, one or more corpses cap speed at 20 km/h; additional corpses add no tiers. Corpses are not obstacles, so auto-drive will not swerve or stop for them.
Force slowdown applies this to everyone; Player choice (default) lets each player use the HUD/options; No corpse slowdown removes only this dedicated cap, while every other safety limit remains active.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveObstaclePoli:
What auto-drive does when the route ahead is blocked.
Dodge (default) means it swerves slightly within the road to get around, and only stops when there is no gap.
Stop means it always slows down and stops, handing control back to the player. Most conservative.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveRightLaneBia:
How far auto-drive shifts to the right of the route, simulating right-hand traffic so oncoming vehicles pass each other naturally.
1.0 (default) shifts into the right lane; 0 disables it and drives along the middle of the route.
Lower it on narrow roads or if the vehicle keeps scraping the roadside.
Takes effect as soon as an admin clicks Apply (applied when auto-drive is restarted).
Sandbox_MinidoracatAutoDriveDebugOverlay: Adds sensor diagnostics: red circles are hard obstacles, orange marks the nearest moving vehicle, and green dots are road-band edges. The regular translucent blue/yellow trajectory is controlled in MOD Options or the mini-map's Autodrive section; this option controls diagnostic markers only. It adds a small client rendering cost, so keep it off normally. Applies immediately after an admin clicks Apply.
